Appointments
Anesthesia
Small and Large Animal Anesthesia Team
Our team of board-certified anesthesiologists (ECVAA:
European College of Veterinary Anaesthesia and Analgesia
and ACVAA:
American College of Veterinary Anesthesiologists
) also supports the operation of the VMC's small animal intensive care unit (ICU). The VMC's anesthesiology team provides a range of services including sedation, anesthesia, post-operative recovery and pain control (analgesic management), ventilation, and critical care management.

Surgery
Small Animal Surgery Team
Our small animal surgical team includes board-certified specialists who are diplomates of the
American College of Veterinary Surgeons
(ACVS). Our small animal surgeons are constantly developing and refining new procedures to apply to the field of surgery.
Our Surgery Team is also made up
Anesthesia
, Rehabilitation and Critical Care.

Small Animal Surgery Services
Large Animal Surgery Team
The WCVM Veterinary Medical Centre's large animal clinical team includes board-certified surgeons who provide a range of soft tissue and orthopedic surgical procedures for large animals.
Their work is supported by registered veterinary technologists who have extensive experience working with large animal patients.
